responsibility: Public interface for the C++ pretty-printer. It defines the cxx_pretty_printer subclass and declares the C++-specific printing entry points and helper wrappers used to render C++ declarations, expressions, types, constraints, requires-expressions, and template syntax for diagnostics and other human-readable output.
same_name_distinction: Declares the cxx_pretty_printer subclass, flags, macros, and C++-specific printing entry points that other files call. Unlike cxx-pretty-print.cc, it does not encode the actual rendering logic for expressions and declarations.
